513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

547-progress.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve my sword, $N?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
547-progress.title: Humbert's Sword

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

95663-accept.name: Kalitor
95663-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Titanic winds carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663-accept.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95663-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95663-complete.text: These are the courageous few? Mind your voices.
95663-complete.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-complete.text: It is a favored sign to have a stranger approach in this manner. I feel a power amidst you... what is this you have brought?
95664-complete.title: Elder Knowledge

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-accept.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-accept.text:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682-accept.title: Open the Maw

95697-complete.name: Borstan
95697-complete.text: Look at the marbling on these! What are they eating up there? Thank you for going all the way and back for us. If you don't mind waiting, we'll cook some for you now, on the house, of course!
95697-complete.title: Changing Tastes

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

96259-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-accept.text:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259-accept.title: Defending the Dead

96261-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
96261-accept.text:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261-accept.title: The Broodmother

96988-accept.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988-accept.title: Source of Power

98094-complete.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98094-complete.text:
Quaint. A fresh face for the field work.

Well, let's see what you have then.
98094-complete.title: Scout Support

98095-accept.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98095-accept.text:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095-accept.title: Valuable Vantages

98823-accept.name: Bashana Runetotem
98823-accept.text:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823-accept.title: Earthen Echo
